## The individual

Conduct a digital-discipleship audit of your own habits and skills; offer your tech skills to your church (website, digital literacy for seniors, media help); commit to continuous learning at the faith-and-technology intersection; keep a regular digital Sabbath as witness and rest; engage online interfaith dialogue on tech ethics with a Christ-centered voice.
